draft_en.subject: Below the Hyperion line - the non-core SKUs BitStream buys in
draft_en.body:
Hi Tomasz,

In January 2025 your colleague asked the price of our 8-port industrial PoE++ managed switch and we answered $140; nothing since, which is fair - that segment is exactly what BitStream builds itself. (Aleksander's auto-reply named you as the contact.)

Where a second line from us usually fits a manufacturer like you is the non-core SKU: DIN-rail 4 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS - model STI-244GP - $35 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); or a cost-optimised 24 x PoE+ + 4 x 10G SFP+ rack unit for project work, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - STC-424XGGPM-280W - $180 (the summer mails said $170; the RMB/USD rate has moved from 7.2 to 6.7 since).

One question: which non-core SKUs does BitStream buy in rather than build?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
